summary: Quick reception registration with first and last name spelled letter by letter, a phone number misread and corrected once, and an Instagram referral. Trap: the receptionist's first read-back of the phone ends in five six seven, the corrected and ground-truth number ends in five seven six.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Good morning madam. First time here? Your name please.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Can you spell the first name?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: S, R, A, V, A, N, I. Sravani. Surname Kodali, K, O, D, A, L, I.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nine eight four nine three, two one five seven six.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Nine eight four nine three, two one five six seven. Correct?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, no, last two are seven six. Five seven six.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Sorry. Nine eight four nine three, two one five seven six.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Madhapur. Flat two zero three, Sai Residency, near Image Gardens.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Madhapur, okay. How did you hear about our clinic?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: On Instagram. I saw the doctor's videos about pigmentation.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Instagram, okay. Registration fee is two hundred rupees, you can pay by UPI here. Please sit, I will call your name.
